issues.title: Clarify existing TGZ dependency mismatch and verification limits
issues.body:
Document that the existing public manifest and lockfile reference different digest-addressed dependency archives, and distinguish repository-policy CI from dependency installation and product-build validation.

Validation: verified the mismatch against the current main manifest/lockfile and reviewed the documentation links. Only README changes; no runtime, package manifest, dependency, lockfile, license or workflow changes. Exact dependency archives are unavailable, so no successful frozen install or product build is claimed.

Maintenance resolution: this repository remains archived after source consolidation. The canonical implementation is maintained in hathq/ihat-store-core. This legacy-only documentation proposal is closed; no legacy release or dependency configuration is reinstated.

issues.title: Clarify usage, outcomes and implementation scope
issues.body:
Readers can see what the repository enables, how to start, and which behavior is implemented. The README and usage guide retain declared dependency prerequisites and distinguish source verification from product or deployment acceptance.

Validation: local Markdown/link checks, source disclosure scan, unchanged license/notice, and existing OSS policy checks where defined. No package publication or deployment is requested.

limits: Issue snapshots preserve observed API records, not unavailable external discussions.
This is preservation evidence, not deletion approval or registry availability.
